Brand is the name of the company under which the product is marketed and sold.
Size refers to the dimensions or measurements of a product.
qualifierDescription: Size refers to the unit used to measure the size of the product. The possible values are inch, cm, m.

attributeDescription: Brand Colour refers to the specific colour or combination of colours that a brand consistently uses in its visual identity, including its logo, packaging, marketing materials, and other brand assets.

Warranty Service Type refers to the process on the customer's part to claim the warranty. In case of any repair/damage to the product, who/where the customer has to contact and how would the company then process the customer's request (either by sending an engineer or by asking the customer to bring the product at a certain Service Center etc).
Pack of refers to the total number of packs that are included by the brand in the sales package.
Tool Usage Type refers to the intended application or purpose of the wrench set, such as automotive, plumbing, or general-purpose use.
Other Dimensions refer to any additional information on the dimensions of the product that would be useful to a customer.
exampleValue: 10cm x 3cm x 3cm||12cm x 4cm x 4cm||8cm x 2.5cm x 2.5cm

attributeDescription: Search Keywords refers to the words which the customer might use to find a product. These keywords are tagged to the product and when the buyer searches with the appropriate search word(s), the nearest appropriate product is retrieved and displayed on Makro website. The search output is also based on multiple other factors such as Product Quality, Pricing, etc. Please enter a maximum of 5 keywords for this purpose.
Model Name is a unique name given to a product by the manufacturer to easily identify or differentiate between products.
exampleValue: Full Polish Metric Combination Wrench Set

attributeDescription: Packaging Type refers to the type of packing the products come in.
Weight refers to the weight of the product only, without packaging.
qualifierDescription: Weight refers to the unit in which weight is being measured. The possible values are kg, lbs, g, oz.

attributeDescription: Adjustable refers to whether the wrenches in the set feature adjustable jaws or heads, allowing users to customize the wrench size for different fastener sizes or applications.
Please write a few lines describing your product. Description is limited to 5000 characters (including spaces). It should not include any hyperlinks, additional offers, or promotion text.
exampleValue: Double open ended spanner is generally used to turn nuts and bolts. It is made up of high quality drop forged steel.

attributeDescription: Jaw Size Scale refers to the range of sizes or dimensions of the wrench jaws, typically expressed in both metric and standard units.
Combination Type refers to the variety of wrench styles or configurations included in the set, such as open-end, box-end, adjustable, or ratcheting.
Rust Resistant refers to the wrench set's ability to resist corrosion or oxidation, maintaining its appearance and performance in humid or corrosive environments.

Colour refers to the shade of the product as mentioned by the brand on the label or sales package. The value 'Multicolour' should be used if the product has a mix of colours that is 3 or more prominent colours on the product.
Material refers to the substance used to make a particular product.
Wrench Type refers to the category or style of wrenches included in the set, such as combination, open-end, box-end, adjustable, or ratcheting.
Flexible Head refers to the ability of the wrench head to pivot or bend, allowing users to access fasteners in confined or awkward spaces with ease.
Other Features refer to any additional information on the features of the product that would be useful to a customer.
exampleValue: Superior quality CRV steel for Durability||Longevity & better Torque

attributeDescription: EAN refers to the 13 digits unique bar code given to each product which is universally recognizable.
Model Number refers to the unique code assigned by the manufacturers to identify the different products that they offer.
Sided refers to the number of sides or faces on each wrench in the set, such as single-sided (open-end), double-sided (box-end), or combination (open-end and box-end).

Warranty Summary refers to the overview of the terms and conditions of the warranty coverage for a product. Mostly one-lined information, this should compulsorily have the number of years covered in warranty and the type (domestic or international) of warranty.
Wrench Set Type refers to the variety and sizes of wrenches included in the set, catering to different needs.

attributeDescription: Sales Package gives the information of all the contents that are sold in the package. Please specify the package information along with the number of each content mentioned before the name. Data should be double pipe (||) separated.
Certifications refer to a document prepared by a notified body that describes and validates the authenticity and key characteristics of a product.
